# @surfaces-ui/seeds

Six synthetic industry data models (retail, healthcare, fraud, telco churn, transportation, manufacturing): generator SQL, descriptions, keys, forms, pipelines and starter surfaces.

Six synthetic industry datasets (retail, healthcare, fraud, telco, transportation, manufacturing) with keys, descriptions, planted data problems, pipelines, starter pages and written conversations.

## Install

```bash
npm install @surfaces-ui/seeds
```

## Part of Surfaces UI

Surfaces UI is a UI library for data and analytics: exploring schemas, querying, charting, tables at scale, chat, and pages an agent can build.
